description: x402-poly-history: Price time series for a Polymarket outcome token, with the trend statistics agents need (first/last price, change in cents and percent, high, low, average, direction, volatility). Pick the window with interval (1m, 1h, 6h, 1d, 1w, max) and the resolution in minutes with fidelity — the upstream floor is 10 for 1m and 5 for 1w. Existing Polymarket services here give a snapshot of the book; this gives where the odds have been.
name: x402-poly-history
